regions.region: title, bibliographic header, abstract, and graphical abstract
regions.finding: The true title/DOI and the current generic picolyl-amide/allenyl-sulfone transformation were transcribed. The graphical abstract duplicates the current generic transformation and was not counted as a second experiment.
Background and cited vinyl-sulfone applications are context. No cited example was promoted to a current-paper experiment.
The 1a/2a/Ni(OTf)2 experiment at 120 °C is the prose occurrence of Table 1 entry 1 and was merged with that row rather than duplicated.

unresolved: The graphical abstract does not state a separate experiment scale, time, or yield.
Structures in the introductory biological examples are contextual and were not exhaustively registered as current-paper chemistry.

regions.finding: Scheme 1a contains biological examples without reaction arrows and is source context. Scheme 1b is one current generic transformation.
Disulfone 5a is explicitly isolated in 10% yield. A separate partial record was retained because the displayed 50 °C/24 h equation is not unambiguously tied to one optimization row.

All eleven optimization rows were recorded separately, including row-specific Ni, NaTs, temperature/time changes, NMR yield, recovered 1a, blank selectivity cells, and zero-yield/decomposition entries.
Solvent effects, recovery, unsuccessful HPLC separation, optimized THF conditions, and the first unreactive 1n/1o/1p observations were associated with their corresponding records.

unresolved: Except for entry 4 (NMR yield), Table 1 does not explicitly state a yield measurement basis in the inspected page.
Blank selectivity cells in entries 4 and 9-11 remain unreported, not zero.
The solvent identity for the separately displayed 5a isolation in Equation 1 is not stated.

regions.region: Figure 1 generic arrow, structures 1b-m/3b-m/4b-m, caption, and footnotes
regions.finding: One generic scheme and twelve distinct substrate-scope experiments were recorded. Each yield and 3/4 ratio is product-targeted; the 1d BRSM value, 1k/1l time notes, and the excluded 85:15 run for 1l were preserved.
Distinct records were made for 1n, 1o, 1p at 50 °C, 1p at room temperature, 2b, and 2c. No product was fabricated for the true no-reaction control; uncharacterizable material remains unresolved.

ICP-MS is analytical source context. The 1c/2a mass-balance study, BHT and AIBN probes, crossover experiment, 1a/5b/K2CO3 negative control, and deuterium-labeling experiment were separated as mechanistic records and linked forward to Scheme 2 where applicable.

unresolved: The Figure 1 arrow says 48 h, while product-specific modified protocols for solids/oils are referred to unavailable SI; unreported row durations were not guessed.
Scope yield measurement bases are not stated on this page.
Products 3b-m/4b-m contain potential unassigned tetrahedral stereochemistry; no racemic claim was inferred.
Detailed conditions for the 1a/5b/K2CO3 control are in unavailable SI.

regions.finding: The BHT, AIBN, crossover, and deuterium-labeling experiments were recorded separately. Scheme 2d isotope contents and four displayed isotopologue percentages were retained as selectivity/composition outcomes; ESI peaks remain source context.

regions.region: interconversion and in situ NMR paragraphs
regions.finding: The charged 59:41 product-mixture control ending at 78:22 and the independent 25.5 h hourly NMR monitoring experiment were kept as distinct mechanistic studies.
All three proposed branches were represented in one proposed-mechanism record with ordered steps; intermediates 6-10 were not treated as isolated products.

unresolved: Positional deuterium mixtures cannot be represented as one unique concrete SMILES.
Charges for the interconversion and in situ NMR experiments are not stated in the bounded page prose.
The proposed mechanism and alternative mechanisms are not experimental proof; unavailable SI was not inferred.

regions.finding: The 1.0 equiv and 0.2 equiv pyridine runs were recorded separately; only the latter has the approximately 17% 5a observation.

regions.region: continuation of proposed mechanism discussion and Scheme 4a-b
regions.finding: Scheme 4 is a DFT acidity model, recorded as a proposed/computational mechanism with the displayed free-energy values, not as a preparative experiment or yield.
Conclusion is narrative. Instrumental and purification-method descriptions were retained as source context and did not create reactions.

unresolved: Temperature, time, solvent, and charges for the N-benzylbenzamide controls are not stated in the bounded paragraph.
DFT values do not establish experimental acidity or isolated intermediates.

regions.finding: Mass-spectrometry and ICP-MS instrument descriptions are characterization context, not reaction experiments.

Aryl- and alkyl-acid amidation procedures were recorded separately with ordered ice-bath addition, 5 min addition, room-temperature 2-4 h hold, recooling, amine addition, overnight hold, workup, and purification steps. The bicarbonate versus hydroxide workups remain distinct.

Solid- and liquid-substrate coupling procedures were recorded separately, including open-air charging, three evacuation/N2 cycles, 50 °C reaction, NMR monitoring, and workup/purification. Only Procedure D explicitly reports 48-72 h.

regions.region: specific preparation paragraphs for 1a, 1b, 1c, and beginning of 1d
regions.finding: Four concrete amidations were recorded with every displayed reagent mass/amount/volume. Product mass, yield, and chromatography were captured for 1a-c; the 1d paragraph crosses to page 7 and remains partial without importing the continuation.

unresolved: The 1d preparation continues beyond the requested page range, so its purification, product amount, yield, and characterization remain unreported in this pass.
General Procedure C completion time is qualitative; no duration was invented.
The SI-only modified protocols referenced for scope substrates were not associated or used.
